Issue 02 / diagram 23. The 45° facing limit (SU-47) alone does not stop this case: C and B face within 45° of each other.
SU-46: chain tension and pivot separation never hold back a troop that is attacking or engaged;
a free friend standing in its way gives way to it instead.
Decision (SU-48): a troop with an attack order does not auto-link until the attack ends.
